title.en: Practice: Speed, work, averages, tables and data sufficiency
title.hi: अभ्यास: चाल, कार्य, औसत, सारणियाँ और आँकड़ों की पर्याप्तता

section: Practice (written by us, not from a UPSC paper): Speed, work, averages, tables and data sufficiency

en.stem: A train 150 metres long runs at 54 km/h. How long does it take to pass a signal pole?
en.why: 54 km/h = 54 x 5/18 = 15 m/s. To pass a pole the train covers its own length: 150 / 15 = 10 seconds.

en.stem: Two trains, 120 metres and 180 metres long, run towards each other on parallel tracks at 40 km/h and 50 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other?
en.why: Relative speed = 40 + 50 = 90 km/h = 25 m/s. Distance = 120 + 180 = 300 m. Time = 300 / 25 = 12 seconds.

en.stem: A person drives from P to Q at 40 km/h and returns by the same road at 60 km/h. What is the average speed for the whole journey?
en.why: Take the distance as 120 km each way. Time out = 3 hours, time back = 2 hours. Average = 240 / 5 = 48 km/h. The formula 2ab / (a + b) gives the same.

en.stem: A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, how long will they take?
en.why: Take the work as 36 units. A does 3 a day, B does 2, together 5. Time = 36 / 5 = 7.2 days. The answer must be less than 12, which removes 15.

en.stem: A and B together finish a job in 10 days. A alone would take 15 days. How long would B alone take?
en.why: B's daily rate = 1/10 - 1/15 = 3/30 - 2/30 = 1/30. B alone takes 30 days.

en.stem: A pipe can fill a tank in 6 hours. A leak at the bottom can empty the full tank in 12 hours. With the leak, how long does the pipe take to fill the tank?
en.why: Net rate = 1/6 - 1/12 = 1/12 of the tank per hour. Time = 12 hours.

en.stem: Twelve workers can finish a job in 15 days. How many workers, at the same rate, are needed to finish it in 9 days?
The average of five numbers is 24. When one number is removed, the average of the remaining four is 22. Which number was removed?
en.why: Total of five = 120. Total of four = 88. Removed = 120 - 88 = 32.

en.stem: The average age of 30 students in a class is 14 years. When the teacher's age is included, the average becomes 15 years. What is the teacher's age?
en.why: Total of students = 420. Total of 31 people = 465. Teacher = 465 - 420 = 45 years.

en.stem: A batter has an average of 40 runs over 9 innings. How many runs are needed in the tenth innings to raise the average to 42?
en.why: Total so far = 360. Total needed for 42 over 10 innings = 420. Runs needed = 60.

en.stem: Twenty kilograms of tea costing 300 rupees a kilogram are mixed with 30 kilograms costing 400 rupees a kilogram. What is the cost of the mixture per kilogram?
en.why: Total cost = 6,000 + 12,000 = 18,000 rupees for 50 kg. Cost = 360 rupees a kilogram. It is nearer 400 because there is more of the dearer tea.

en.stem: A firm's sales in the four quarters of a year were 120, 150, 180 and 150 lakh rupees. What share of the year's sales came in the third quarter?
en.why: Total = 600. Share of the third quarter = 180 / 600 = 30%.

en.stem: Using the same figures (120, 150, 180 and 150 lakh rupees), by what per cent did sales rise from the first quarter to the third?
en.why: Change = 180 - 120 = 60. Base is the earlier value, 120. Rise = 60 / 120 = 50%. Dividing by 180 gives 33.33%, which is the trap.

en.stem: A boat moves at 12 km/h in still water. The stream flows at 3 km/h. How long does the boat take to travel 45 km downstream?
en.why: Downstream speed = 12 + 3 = 15 km/h. Time = 45 / 15 = 3 hours. Five hours is the time upstream.

en.stem: Question: What is the value of x? Statement 1: x + y = 10. Statement 2: x - y = 4. Which is correct?
options: Even both statements together are not sufficient
en.why: Each statement alone has two unknowns and allows many values of x. Together they are two different equations in two unknowns, which fix x (x = 7). There is no need to solve to see that.
